reasoning.step1:
1) Classify document as invoice:
- Presence of keywords: "Rechnung", "Rechnungsdatum", "Warenwert", "MWST", "Endbetrag", invoice number ("Belegnummer") — strongly indicates an invoice.
- No exclusion terms ("Mahnung", "Zahlungserinnerung", "Servicebericht") prominent. => Treat as invoice and proceed.

2) Identify fields to extract per schema:
- GrandTotal.Amount: look for total payable ("Endbetrag (EUR)").
- Invoice.Date: look for "Rechnungsdatum".
- Sender.VatId: sender VAT ID labeled "Unsere USt-ID".
- Vat.Rate: VAT percentage(s) listed (MWST / Ausgangssteuer).
- Net.Amount: net amount (Warenwert / Nettowert) corresponding to VAT group.
- Vat.Amount: VAT amount for VAT group.

3) Locate candidates in text and consider alternatives/ambiguities:
- Invoice date: "Rechnungsdatum                  26.01.2024" — clear, use "26.01.2024".
- Sender VAT ID: two USt-IDs present:
  - "Unsere USt-ID: ATU76204938" (sender)
  - "Ihre USt-ID: ATU22642807" (recipient)
  Schema asks for Sender.VatId => choose "ATU76204938".
- Grand total: "Endbetrag              (EUR)                                                  910,01" — clear candidate: 910,01 EUR.
- Net amount: several "Nettowert" lines and summary "Warenwert               Netto                                                 827,28" — use 827,28.
  Alternative: there are net values per line (459,60 and 367,68) that sum to 827,28; the summary 827,28 is appropriate for invoice-level Net.Amount.
- VAT rate and VAT amount: block shows:
  - "Ausgangssteuer                  1   =    10%:                                   82,73"
  - Also header shows "MWST %", and line items show 10% per line.
  => Single VAT group 10% with VAT amount 82,73.
- Numeric formatting: input uses comma as decimal separator; schema requires numbers. Convert to dot decimals, preserving decimals as in input (two decimals).

4) Check No Inference policy:
- All chosen values are explicitly present; no guessing required.

5) Final mapping (values to be placed in final JSON):
- GrandTotal.Amount -> 910.01 (number)
- Invoice.Date -> "26.01.2024" (string)
- Sender.VatId -> "ATU76204938" (string)
- Vat.Rate -> 10 (number; drop percent sign)
- Net.Amount -> 827.28 (number)
- Vat.Amount -> 82.73 (number)

6) Verify consistency:
- Net 827.28 + VAT 82.73 = 910.01 (matches GrandTotal) — consistent.

Proceed to produce final JSON with these extracted values.
